newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end stable on NCD issue.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end stable on NCD issue.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed stable on Thursday following the central bank's issue of T$3 billion negotiable certificates of deposit to tighten liquidity before an upcoming holiday, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate ended at 5.993 percent against Wednesday's 5.995 close, with 30-day commercial paper unchanged at 5.95-6.00 percent.

The NCD issue was the central bank's second mop-up measure in two days. The bank had said Wednesday's issue aimed to absorb extra money before the upcoming two-day holiday on March 29-30 and was not an effort to dampen stock market turnover.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.1050 percent against 6.0875 and the 10-year 84/1 bond yield was at 5.9400 against 5.9300.
